subject: Merchant Labs onboarding — purchase ID limbo & line-item cleanup
messages:
From: Lara Gauthier <lara@merchantlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Merchant Labs onboarding — missing PO and invoice line items

Hi David / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the contract. We're trying to submit our first invoice but it looks like the PO number in the portal shows as "pending" (no numeric ID) and the billing team flagged two line items that don't match the SKU tags we sent earlier. Attached is our onboarding form and a snapshot of the invoice (invoice_lineitems_snapshot.csv) with the rows highlighted.

Can you confirm whether you can issue a hard PO or provide a provisional reference we can use to get the invoice processed so we don't miss the month-end run? We also need confirmation of the initial spend cap for the first billing cycle so our finance team can reconcile.

Attaching: merchant_onboarding_form.pdf, invoice_lineitems_snapshot.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Lara Gauthier
Head of Finance, Merchant Labs
lara@merchantlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Gauthier <lara@merchantlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant Labs onboarding — missing PO and invoice line items

Hi Lara — thanks for the details and the attachments.

Quick summary of next steps from our side: 
- Monica (procurement ops) will validate the onboarding form and confirm whether any required tax/vendor fields are missing.
- We can provision a provisional PO reference immediately (for invoice routing) but final PO issuance requires completed onboarding and an approved spend cap.

Monica — could you review the attached CSV and tell Lara which SKU tags map to Redwood ledger codes? If possible please also indicate what minimal additional info (if any) is blocking a permanent PO.

Lara — if you can provide the merchant tax form (W-8/W-9 equivalent) or the vendor tax ID in the onboarding form, that will speed final PO creation. For now we can issue a provisional reference: RED-PRV-9812 for processing; this is not a final purchase serial and we'll follow up with a permanent PO once the onboarding is closed.

I'll mark this high priority since it's month-end for you.

—David
David Kim
Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Gauthier <lara@merchantlabs.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant Labs onboarding — missing PO and invoice line items

Hi Lara — thanks for sending the CSV. I went through the snapshot and added inline notes (see attached merchant_onboarding_form.pdf with redline) but summary below: 

- Line item 2 (SaaS seat add-on) is missing the SKU suffix we use for taxable services. Please update the invoice to include SKU ML-SAA-03 so our ledger tags reconcile automatically.
- Line item 4 appears to be a one-time setup fee but the invoice labels it as "recurring"; please correct to "one-time" and include the service start date (2027-06-01).
- Vendor tax ID is missing in the onboarding form; we need that (or W-8/W-9) to finalize a permanent PO.

While you update, we'll create a provisional PO PDF you can use to route for internal approvals — attached prov_po_9812.pdf. This will let your billing team post the invoice to our AR system so you hit their cycle.

Please re-submit the corrected invoice and updated onboarding form. If you want I can take the corrected CSV and run it through our ledger preview to show the post-fix mapping.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Lara Gauthier <lara@merchantlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant Labs onboarding — missing PO and invoice line items

Monica / David — thanks for the quick turn. Attached: corrected onboarding form (filled vendor tax ID), updated invoice CSV with SKU ML-SAA-03 for line 2, and we changed line 4 to one-time and added the start date. We also uploaded the signed onboarding PDF to the Drive folder you shared.

We used the provisional reference RED-PRV-9812 when we submitted the invoice to our finance system. Can you confirm the spend cap that will be enforced for the first 30 days so we can program our billing alerts? Our accounts team asked for the numeric cap and whether it is adjustable without a new PO.

Also copying Grace to confirm the ledger mapping once you run the preview. Appreciate it — this should clear the month-end hold.

Attachments: merchant_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, invoice_lineitems_snapshot_v2.csv

Best,
Lara
Head of Finance, Merchant Labs
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Gauthier <lara@merchantlabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchant Labs onboarding — missing PO and invoice line items

Thanks Lara — I ran the updated CSV through ledger preview. Confirmations: 
- Ledger tags map cleanly after the SKU fix; we estimate no manual rework on our end.
- Provisional spend cap for first 30 days: $45,000 USD (this is enforced as a soft cap — invoices over this amount will route to escalation but will still be accepted with manual approval).
- Permanent PO issuance: pending final vendor tax doc verification (we received the tax ID in the form; compliance will do a quick check and issue final PO within 2 business days).

Action items: 
- Lara: confirm you received prov_po_9812 and that your billing team has posted under RED-PRV-9812.
- Monica: after compliance clears tax ID, please publish the permanent PO and send the PO number to Lara.
- David: I recommend noting the soft-cap terms in the HubSpot deal record (DL-ML-2027-113) and flagging for finance as a month-one exception.

I'll mark this as resolved once the final PO is published.

—Grace
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
